description: The lot notched at its north-east corner (six edges; the notch's two are rear edges), a rear setback of 7' and a shed's pad near the notch's inner corner, (30', 20'): the shed's corner (26', 16') is beyond the ends of both of the notch's edges, so its distance to them is to that corner, sqrt(32) feet - FS-SITE-LINT-003 for the shed's pad.
